native_diagnostic.decision: Original true/empty/shuffled fidelity gate and thresholds remain unchanged. Random and independent per-condition diagnostics do not rescue a gate failure.

isolation: Parent sets ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES; lane uses cuda:0 and changes no GPU visibility settings.

memory.placement: Native source, AV and AR resident on one GPU and fully frozen during calibration. Continual mode separately permits source LoRA updates only after a passed native gate.

resume: Set resume=true and reuse output-dir with exactly the same config (except resume) and code. Training resumes from complete optimizer steps with adapter/optimizer/RNG state; evaluation resumes per item and condition.
scope: Weight-based acquisition, retention and readout drift. No context/KV repair, online model downloads, cluster mutation, service credentials or cross-model decoding.
pilot_limit: The small one-update config deliberately permits insufficient heldout prediction samples and reports no forecast score in that case. The sequential config increases entities and adds a matched-budget update on disjoint new bindings.
